steps.margin_note: Biological control, and the specificity. Four lines.

steps.why: A virus that attacks only one insect species can remove a pest without touching anything else in the field.
common_mistakes: Saying it is used to treat plant diseases. It is used to KILL insect pests.
Saying it kills all insects. It is species SPECIFIC — that is the point.
steps.memory_tip: A virus used as an insecticide.

steps.why: A chemical insecticide kills the pest's predators as well, which often makes the next outbreak worse; a species-specific virus does not.
common_mistakes: Not expanding IPM. Integrated Pest Management is the term.
Saying it is harmful to other species. Its lack of harm is exactly why it is used.
steps.memory_tip: It leaves the useful insects alone.
